anchor_definition: The anchor is the crypto module's encrypt function (exported as I.e, local name u): it parses the fixed AES key G3JH98Y8MY9GWKWG, runs AES-ECB/Pkcs7 over the plaintext and URL-encodes the base64 — i.e. it constructs the password ciphertext. PLAN §5.1: the dedicated value-constructing function is the anchor, not the submit handler (callback) that assembles the payload nor the outer encode wrapper, and not the inverse decrypt.

anchor.why: AES-ECB(Pkcs7) encrypt of the plaintext with the fixed key G3JH98Y8MY9GWKWG, then encodeURIComponent(base64). Exposed on the Vue prototype as this.encrypt (prototype.encrypt = I.e). It produces the password ciphertext used in the login request.

roles.why: The login submit handler: assembles the request payload o = {account, password: encode(encrypt(password)), ...} and sends it. It triggers encryption but only forwards to this.encrypt.
The inverse decrypt function (exported as I.b / this.decrypt). Opposite direction; not on the request-construction path.
